patterns.note: The hero section employs a split-screen layout, with a solid brand color and text on the left, and a lifestyle image on the right, creating a dynamic visual balance.
A vibrant, deep red (#C23934) is used as a primary brand accent, notably in the hero background and for key interactive elements, contrasting with a light peach (#FFB75D) for informational sections.
Headings use a clear, bold sans-serif font with significant size variation to establish a strong visual hierarchy, while body text remains highly legible and functional.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, often using alternating background colors (white, peach, red) to visually separate different categories of information.
The page exhibits no scroll-triggered animations or sticky elements; content simply scrolls into and out of view in a standard browser fashion.

technique_notes: The hero section is constructed with a two-column grid where one column has a solid background color and text, and the other contains a full-height image, ensuring both brand messaging and visual appeal are prominent.
Informational sections are presented as two-column cards or content blocks, each with a distinct icon and title, contained within a full-width background color block.
The site relies on standard browser scrolling for content reveal, with no custom scroll-triggered animations or sticky header effects implemented.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3x body) create strong focal points, complemented by clear, readable body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card-like elements provides a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and consistent vertical padding between sections and within content blocks creates a clean, organized layout without feeling overly dense or airy.

standout: The site's distinctive split-screen hero, combining a vibrant, solid brand color with an engaging lifestyle photo, immediately establishes a clear brand identity. This strong visual anchor, coupled with a functional and clearly segmented layout, makes the site feel both professional and approachable.
